description: Bubblegum Bling is an aesthetic that emerged in the late 2010s as a revival and reinterpretation of the McBling style of the mid-to-late 2000s. It is a prominent part of the broader Neo-Y2K movement and is heavily influenced by the sound and visuals of the Hyperpop and PC Music scenes. The aesthetic is highly popular on social media platforms like TikTok and Instagram, where it is frequently simply called "Y2K." The name, coined by researcher tranquility2099, is a portmanteau of " Bubblegum Bass ," a music genre pioneered by artists like SOPHIE, and "McBling," the aesthetic it revives. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Futuristic femininity, sleek luxury, glamour, kitsch, digital culture
